issues.title: Smart quotes in TypeScript/TSX files breaking parser
issues.description: 34 TypeScript/JSX files contained curly/smart quotes (', ', ", —, –) instead of straight quotes, causing Turbopack parser failures.
issues.fix: Replaced all smart quotes with straight quotes globally

issues.title: Missing type module in package.json causes Turbopack overhead
issues.description: tailwind.config.ts is reparsed as ES module on every build due to ambiguous module type, incurring performance penalty.
issues.impact: Slower build times (25-36ms overhead per build)

issues.title: Large JSX page components (100-120 lines)
issues.description: 81 functions exceed 100 lines, mostly in page.tsx files
issues.impact: Harder to test, reuse, and maintain
issues.recommendation: Extract data arrays and complex JSX sections into separate components

issues.title: Console.log statements left in source
issues.description: 31 console statements found in app code

issues.title: Moderate bundle sizes - largest chunk 222 KB

issues.title: Minimal error recovery in API routes
issues.description: API routes have try-catch but limited error context
issues.recommendation: Add structured error codes and logging
